generationInputs.prompt: A skeletal figure clad in black armor and a helmet adorned with a red plume rides a white horse turned to the right. The figure holds a black banner displaying a stylized white rose with five petals and a yellow center. The horse has a black bridle and saddle. Beneath the horse's front legs, a young girl with brown hair in pigtails, wearing a blue dress, looks upwards with clasped hands. To her right, an older male figure with a light skin tone and gray hair visible under a yellow and green patterned robe and hat kneels with hands clasped in prayer. Further right, a light-skinned figure lies on the ground, enveloped in a white shroud.
